model_rules: Separate housing, open slider, spring contacts and seating stop.
Use separate convex pieces or a cavity-preserving static mesh; never a single convex hull across the opening.
Do not infer cable insertion force from actuator operation or locked retention force.
Parameterize undimensioned lead-ins; include square-edge and narrower-clearance cases.
Preserve experiment 043 archives; the optional experiment 045 socket consumes these reference dimensions with separately recorded assumptions.
